message: 幼馴染みは振り向かない

name: Ria
message: 「Heeey, everyone, tea's ready\s04」
Break tiiime in between setting things up. A warrior's rest.

name: Misa
message: 「Come to think of it... Nanaka-san and Sakura-kun are childhood friends, aren't you」

name: Paqy
message: 「At least remember that much. Hiss」

name: Misa
message: 「I was just confirming!」

name: Ria
message: 「Was there some kind of trigger for it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's old man and my dad were friends, so our families have hung out together since before we were even born」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That would be what they call 'misery loves company,' yes」

name: Ria
message: 「I think you've got that wrong\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now that I think about it, we've been together practically since we were born」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now those are textbook childhood friends」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahem. How's that!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not really something to brag about」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nah, being together this long is kinda amazing, isn't it」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're sick of each other」

name: Sally
message: 「If you get sick of each other, it's best not to see one another for like 100 years. Then when you finally meet again--」

name: Misa
message: 「It feels brand new, right」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep. You've both forgotten each other's faces and names, so it's super fresh!」

name: Misa
message: 「...My head hurts」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not really sick of her or anything. We're practically like family anyway」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, yeah. Totally, family, family」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fufufu. This is truly a case of 'a frog in a well knows nothing of the great ocean'」

name: Ria
message: 「Listen, Lolotte-chan. I think it'd be good for you to consult a regular dictionary every once in a while」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My childhood friend won't lose out either. We've been together since the day we were born!」

name: Ria
message: 「...It's sad when people ignore you\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「That is not true at all! I, for one, am always listening intently\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me listens to every single word Ria-chan says too, right down to her fragrant sighs!」

name: Misa
message: 「What was that?! I listen at least that closely too!」

name: Sally
message: 「Woooow. You two both have really good ears!」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't need to listen that closely\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When you've known each other that long, you must have tons of childhood memories. Exciting!」

name: Ria
message: 「Exciting?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to hear some funny stories about the President.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Funny stories, huh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Knowing Sakura-kun, I imagine he has plenty of clumsy stories.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah, my life's pretty ordinary.」
Though the biggest surprise was being the Demon Lord. Not that I can say that.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer. Put your pride as a childhood friend on the line and give us a funny story!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't tell me you don't have any? You're childhood friends, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahh, when Synn was little, he was obsessed with transforming heroes, tied a wrapping cloth around his shoulders, and jumped off the second floor of my house.」

name: Misa
message: 「How childish of him.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, he was a child.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm surprised you remembered that.」

name: Ria
message: 「What were you doing at the time, Nanaka-chan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I watched, thinking he probably wouldn't fly.」

name: Misa
message: 「Stop him!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But, you know, on the off chance he actually flew, that would've been hilarious.」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't fly」

name: Sally
message: 「You can fly. It's easy」

name: Everyone
message: 「That's only because you're a Demon!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, right after that, Nanaka ran off crying to call for help for me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even a demon sheds tears, I see」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who're you calling a demon」

name: Ria
message: 「Heh, Nanaka-chan actually cried~」

name: Misa
message: 「Even Nanaka-san cries sometimes. Probably」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh. So even Nanaka cries」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um... I'd really like to ask you all what kind of person you think I am sometime」

name: Ria
message: 「Wait, was Synn-kun seriously hurt?」

name: Synn
message: 「It wasn't really that big of a deal」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, come on, Synn's leg was bent in a direction no human's should bend. His toes were pointing backward」

name: Ria
message: 「...I couldn't help picturing that」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, that sure hurt back then」

name: Sally
message: 「Kaichou is such a wimp. Getting messed up like that just from falling from the second floor」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because he's not like you」

name: Synn
message: 「And so I ended up having to stay in the hospital」

name: Ria
message: 「And Nanaka-chan came to visit you every single day, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I wonder how often it was?」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like it was around twice a week...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Was... it really?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's rather cold-hearted for a childhood friend」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed, she didn't even stop him when he jumped off the second floor」

name: Sally
message: 「I won't stop you. The second floor is only about twice your height, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're a Demon, aren't you? And you can fly too」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, she came twice a week and took really good care of you, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka was always eating the fruit people brought as get-well gifts」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I peeled it for you, didn't I!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. But you ate way more of it, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you barely ate any even after I went through the trouble of peeling it for you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So I figured it'd be a waste to leave it」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you were eating it like it was the best thing ever」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you saying it's my fault!」

name: Sally
message: 「If there's something delicious right in front of you, it can't be helped」

name: Misa
message: 「Those were get-well gifts for a patient, you know」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, I mean, she was just a kid back then……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aren't there any other heartwarming stories from when you were in the hospital?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not really. He was discharged in less than a month」

name: Synn
message: 「……Oh, now that I think about it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Beds seemed like a novelty to Nanaka, so she used to jump up and down on mine all the time」

name: Ria
message: 「How adorable~\s05」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There was that time I accidentally landed right on your foot, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「That hurt」

name: Misa
message: 「It suddenly stopped being heartwarming…… And besides, nobody normally does that」

name: Sally
message: 「People normally do」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, that was, uh…… because I was a kid」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Listen to me. Just because they're a kid doesn't mean anything goes. As they say, the soul of a three-year-old lasts until a hundred.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's family uses futons! The feeling of springs was just a novelty!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, yeah! If it was a novelty, it couldn't be helped, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, they're a kid, so it can't be helped.」

name: Misa
message: 「If Big Sister says so, then that must be right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If Senpai says so, then it can't be helped.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, everyone's convinced even though those aren't the words of the person involved!」

name: Synn
message: 「Because they're Ria-senpai's words.」

name: Misa
message: 「And it's what Ria-senpai is saying.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And Senpai is the one saying it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Those are Ria-chan's words, man.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, everything worked out peacefully, so isn't it fine?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Something about this just doesn't sit right with meeeeeee!」
